import datetime

data = [
(1975,16.91),(1976,20.46),(1977,25.17),(1978,30.2),(1979,35.67),(1980,41.86),(1981,45.26),(1982,40.03),(1983,47.5),(1984,49),(1985,51.76),(1986,55.43),(1987,61.53),(1988,74.92),(1989,93.82),(1990,98.38),(1991,96.45),(1992,94.36),(1993,87.5),(1994,82.36),(1995,78.62),(1996,77.89),(1997,78.95),(1998,86.69),(1999,91.84),(2000,100),(2001,109.68),(2002,123.5),(2003,138.67),(2004,172.78),(2005,219.47),(2006,255.34),(2007,253.85),(2008,208.17),(2009,175.88),(2010,174.33),(2011,166.07),(2012,165.26),(2013,180.41),(2014,204.42),(2015,215.92),(2016,232.25),(2017,248.16),(2018,264.82),(2019,274.07),(2020,281.48),(2021,313.89),(2022,362.6),(2023,375.2)
]

# recent 5-year growth
recent = data[-5:]
print('Recent 5 years:', recent)
for i in range(1, len(recent)):
    y, v = recent[i]
    py, pv = recent[i-1]
    print(f'{y}: {v}, YoY growth: {(v/pv-1)*100:.2f}%')

# 10-year average growth
last10 = data[-10:]
start = last10[0][1]
end = last10[-1][1]
print(f'10-year (2014-2023) total growth: {(end/start-1)*100:.2f}%, CAGR: {((end/start)**(1/9)-1)*100:.2f}%')

# 5-year average growth
last5 = data[-5:]
start5 = last5[0][1]
end5 = last5[-1][1]
print(f'5-year (2019-2023) total growth: {(end5/start5-1)*100:.2f}%, CAGR: {((end5/start5)**(1/4)-1)*100:.2f}%')

# simple linear regression on last 10 years for prediction
import numpy as np
xs = np.array([d[0] for d in last10], dtype=float)
ys = np.array([d[1] for d in last10], dtype=float)

print(f'Avg YoY growth last 5y: {avg*100:.2f}%')
